text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—Even though that light should have been 
gone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Why is that in front of me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel! Sakura Laurel bursts out 
from the pack!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Sakura! Sakura!! Will the cherry 
blossoms bloom in full glory against the 
world?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —What is that... back?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (...Come to me.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —What is that... speed?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (...Come here!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Why that running style...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —...gh, Aaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Come at me! Narita Brian!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Kh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That was—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —No.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! It's completely wrong!! And 
yet—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —...I want it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I want that! I want running that can 
surpass that!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If it's different from what I've been 
chasing all along! If my current breathing 
can't catch up to that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I just have to become a different me than 
beforeâ!!

text_block_list.name: Laurel & Brian
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaahhhhh!! Nggaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...!! She's... accelerating. Narita Brian 
is—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: ...Go for it, Brian! Go! Run!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Go, gooo—!! GOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel crosses the line first! In 
the heart of autumn! Facing down the 
world! —The cherry blossoms have scattered 
the competition!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... *sigh*â...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haa..., haa...! Sakura... Laurel...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Where—are you going?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Beyond you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"It's not over yet. Spring, when the 
cherry blossoms bloom, has only just 
begun."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hahaha... Ahhahahaha! Ahhh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Don't think you can escape next time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yeah—I won't lose either.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha. Look at that, you've got a great 
look on your face."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Feeling gloomy over that was so silly. 
Alright then, I'll—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Next time, how about I just beat the crap 
out of all of you at once...!

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we've just received new footage 
from Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel, who conquered this year's 
Japan Cup, and Mayano Top Gun, building 
unstoppable momentum in the Classic Year!

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Additionally, the valkyrie Hishi Amazon 
appears to be hard at work training! And—"

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And there's footage of Narita Brian too! 
Exciting news has also come in that these 
four will clash in this year's Arima 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Man, this year's Arima Kinen is shaping 
up to be a Grand Prix truly worthy of 
year's end!"

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And Narita Brian's form seems to be 
returning to how it was before her injury! 
What are your thoughts, commentators?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Though I believe my 
situation is a bit different from simply 
'returning.'

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's form has changed since 
before her injury. It's no longer the 
running that earned her the title of "The 
Strongest."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"...And from here on out, this is just my 
personal theory, but—"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Her fighting spirit didn't waver even 
after her injury. As a result, perhaps she 
was able to discover a new way of running.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
So rather than saying I've "returned," I 
feel it's better to say I've "moved 
forward."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Brian wasn't a finished monster. She was 
an Umamusume who would continue to grow, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Looking forward to training with 
you today, as always!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Brian-chan will come back even 
stronger for the Arima Kinen!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best so we don't lose!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Aaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Even though Maya found it first! Maya was 
the one who found it, you know?! And yet—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Don't hog all of Maya's sparkle to 
yourself, Laurel-san~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: M-Maya-chan...!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mmm☆ Seems like Mayano was frustrated! 
Seeing everyone have so much fun running 
in the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So we're gonna run together too! In the 
year-end 'Arima Kinen' ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmmh~... There's no way I'm gonna lose...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's gonna take first place, just you 
watch!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Mayano Top Gun spoke with teary 
eyes, she had put on a flawless victory in 
this year's Kikuka Sho, and her genius was 
the talk of the town.
choice_data_list:
Looks like we've got another formidable 
rival on our hands.

Looks like we've got a new formidable 
rival, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes. That is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Fwhooooosh――!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, a gust of wind blew in— as 
if announcing the arrival of the next 
season.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's enjoy the festival before the new 
year arrives☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Mm-hmm, let's do this♪ Mave-chan, 
Maya-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toward the Arima Kinen, the culmination of 
the year. The Umamusume began walking 
their paths—
